title: ReuScope: Auditing Data Reuse and Evaluation Sensitivity in Capsule Vision 2024
abstract: arXiv:2610.41835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop ReuScope, a protocol for auditing data reuse and evaluation sensitivity, using Capsule Vision 2024 as a case study. It combines measurements of data relationships with two comparisons: changing the evaluation population while holding predictions fixed, and changing training data while holding evaluation fixed. Byte-identical files cross the public training-validation boundary, and all 41 Kvasir-Capsule recordings that contribute frames occur in both partitions. Shared source recordings establish cross-split overlap; missing cross-recording patient identifiers prevent counting unique shared patients. Across ten paired seeds, removing all training rows attributed to Kvasir-Capsule, plus five rows from other sources flagged as near-matches to it, lowers public-validation balanced accuracy from 82.5% to 61.2%. translated_title: ReuScope：审计 Capsule Vision 2024 中的数据复用与评估敏感性
translated_abstract: 我们开发了 ReuScope，这是一个用于审计数据复用与评估敏感性的协议，并以 Capsule Vision 2024 作为案例研究。该协议将数据关系的测量与两种对比实验相结合：在保持预测结果固定的情况下改变评估人群，以及在保持评估集固定的情况下改变训练数据。研究发现，存在字节完全相同的文件跨越了公开的训练集与验证集边界，且所有提供帧数据的 41 个 Kvasir-Capsule 录像同时出现在两个分区中。共享的源录像确立了跨分区重叠；但由于缺失跨录像的患者标识符，无法统计唯一的共享患者数量。在十组配对随机种子的实验中，删除所有归属于 Kvasir-Capsule 的训练数据行，加上来自其他数据源、被标记为与其近乎匹配的五行数据后，模型在公开验证集上的平衡准确率从 82.5% 降至 61.2%。而当用同一批已拟合模型评估其他数据源的验证数据行时，比较结果发生了逆转：删除操作反而提升了平衡准确率……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 ReuScope 审计协议，发现 Capsule Vision 2024 竞赛的训练集与验证集存在字节级相同文件和共享源录像等数据复用问题，删除这些复用数据后公开验证集平衡准确率从 82.5% 骤降至 61.2%，揭示了竞赛评估结果对数据复用的高度敏感性。
en_tdlr: ReuScope, a protocol for auditing data reuse and evaluation sensitivity, reveals that Capsule Vision 2024 contains byte-identical files and shared source recordings across train-validation splits, and removing such reused training data drops public-validation balanced accuracy from 82.5% to 61.2%.
